create_stg
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS dlh.oil_stg
create_mart
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS dlh.oil_mart
stage_events

CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_stg.event_log WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT e.* FROM greenplum_gp.oil_stg.event_log e JOIN greenplum_gp.oil_stg.v_event_parsed p ON e.topic=p.topic AND e.kafka_partition=p.kafka_partition AND e.kafka_offset=p.kafka_offset WHERE p.event_type IN ('field','well','production_day')
dds_event
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.event WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.event WHERE event_type IN ('field','well','production_day')
dds_hub_field
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.hub_field WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.hub_field
dds_hub_well
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.hub_well WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.hub_well
dds_hub_production_day
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.hub_production_day WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.hub_production_day
dds_link_well_field
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.link_well_field WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.link_well_field
dds_link_production_day_well
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.link_production_day_well WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.link_production_day_well
dds_sat_field
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.sat_field WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.sat_field
dds_sat_well
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.sat_well WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.sat_well
dds_sat_daily_production
CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_dds.sat_daily_production WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT * FROM greenplum_gp.oil_dds.sat_daily_production
dim_field

CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_mart.dim_field WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT field_hk,entity_version,event_time AS valid_from,lead(event_time) OVER(PARTITION BY field_hk ORDER BY event_time,entity_version) AS valid_to,field_name,region,(op='D') AS is_deleted FROM dlh.oil_dds.sat_field
dim_well

CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_mart.dim_well WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT w.well_hk,l.field_hk,w.entity_version,w.valid_from,lead(w.valid_from) OVER(PARTITION BY w.well_hk ORDER BY w.valid_from,w.entity_version) AS valid_to,w.well_name,w.status,(w.op='D') AS is_deleted FROM dlh.oil_dds.sat_well w JOIN dlh.oil_dds.link_well_field l ON l.link_hk=w.link_hk
fact_well_day

CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_mart.fact_well_day WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT p.production_hk,l.well_hk,w.field_hk,p.production_date,w.entity_version AS well_version,f.entity_version AS field_version,p.status,p.oil_tonnes FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY production_hk ORDER BY entity_version DESC,event_id DESC) rn FROM dlh.oil_dds.sat_daily_production) p JOIN dlh.oil_dds.link_production_day_well l ON l.link_hk=p.link_hk JOIN dlh.oil_mart.dim_well w ON w.well_hk=l.well_hk AND NOT w.is_deleted AND w.valid_from<=p.production_date AND (w.valid_to IS NULL OR p.production_date<w.valid_to) JOIN dlh.oil_mart.dim_field f ON f.field_hk=w.field_hk AND NOT f.is_deleted AND f.valid_from<=(CAST(p.production_date AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND (f.valid_to IS NULL OR (CAST(p.production_date AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')<f.valid_to) WHERE p.rn=1 AND p.op='U'
agg_field_day

CREATE TABLE dlh.oil_mart.agg_field_day WITH (format='PARQUET') AS SELECT p.production_date,p.field_hk,f.field_name,f.region,CAST(sum(p.oil_tonnes) AS DECIMAL(22,3)) AS oil_tonnes,CAST(sum(CASE WHEN p.status='ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS producing_well_days,CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN p.status='ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(22,6)) ELSE CAST(sum(p.oil_tonnes)/sum(CASE WHEN p.status='ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(22,6)) END AS oil_per_well_day FROM dlh.oil_mart.fact_well_day p JOIN dlh.oil_mart.dim_field f ON f.field_hk=p.field_hk AND f.entity_version=p.field_version GROUP BY p.production_date,p.field_hk,f.field_name,f.region
view
CREATE VIEW dlh.oil_mart.v_field_production AS SELECT * FROM dlh.oil_mart.agg_field_day
view_security_invoker
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dlh.oil_mart.v_field_production SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT * FROM dlh.oil_mart.agg_field_day
